en.html:
After spending far more time than should have been necessary, I finally reached the next station.

...How long had it been since Muramasa was taken?

Even thinking about it would cost time. And I did not want to think. Without looking to either side, I rushed into the station.

Where?
Where had they gone from here?!

Had nobody seen them?!
No. Somebody... one person, at least!

Muramasa.
Saying her name, I felt how much was missing.

She was not beside me. The one who had never left me for even a moment was not here.

And I wanted her here.

Now that I had lost her, I felt it with all its weight.

This was love. There was no doubt about it.

I loved her.
I wanted her.

I needed her—

en.html:
With an irritated click of his tongue, the man turned. His footsteps were heavy as he started to walk away.

Why?
Why would he not understand?

This moment mattered! Whether I could save the person I loved depended on it!

That much also he would not understand?!

　大切な時なのに！
　愛する人を救えるか、その瀬戸際なのに！

　どうして理解してくれないのだ!?

I was about to run after him when something caught my eye.

The station message board.

In one corner, a short piece of writing.
Signed: Sorimachi.

...It was a message for me.
